title: Use kebab-case for logical identifiers and snake_case for plan filesystem paths

facts.note: Any write that creates, renames or edits a logical identifier (URN, slug field, YAML reference) or a plan directory/file. Edits to existing files count when they touch a URN, slug field or YAML reference, whatever entity it names.

Branch A (filesystem): directories, manifests and feature files under plan/**. Branch B (logical identifiers): any file, inside or outside plan/, that holds a URN, slug field or YAML reference. Either branch alone activates the rule; plan/** does not gate Branch B, and Branch B is not limited to any entity type.
Manifests are named _{dirname}.yaml; feature files sit under features/. Other file kinds are in scope only through Branch B.

A diff-level observer must detect (Branch B) any URN, slug or YAML ref value added or changed in any file, regardless of the entity type it names, or (Branch A) a plan directory/file created or renamed. Either change activates the rule.
Supporting signal only, not a gate.

fires: Planner creates a new wagon directory under plan/ and its _{dirname}.yaml manifest
Planner adds a feature file under plan/{wagon_dirname}/features/
Planner writes or edits any URN, slug field or YAML reference in any file, inside or outside plan/, whatever entity it names
Planner renames an entity, so both its slug and its plan path change
doesNotFire: Edits to the body of an existing plan file that change no URNs, slugs, refs, filenames or directory names
Changes to files outside plan/ that add or change no URNs, slug fields or YAML refs

given: A planner writes a logical identifier (any URN, slug field or YAML ref, in any file) or a plan filesystem artifact (directory, manifest file, feature file)
when: The planner writes or edits the identifier, or creates or renames the path
then: Write logical identifiers in kebab-case. Name filesystem artifacts in snake_case: plan/{wagon_dirname}/, manifest plan/{dirname}/_{dirname}.yaml, features plan/{wagon_dirname}/features/{feature_name}.yaml.
prefer: Follow the source example: feature:authenticate-identity:verify-session -> plan/authenticate_identity/ + _authenticate_identity.yaml + features/verify_session.yaml
Name the manifest after the directory, not the slug: _{dirname}.yaml
avoid: Hyphenated directory or feature file names under plan/ because the URN uses hyphens
Underscored values in any URN, slug field or YAML ref
Naming the manifest after the kebab slug (_{slug}.yaml)
why: Consistent filesystem naming reduces conversion complexity and keeps logical (kebab) and physical (snake) identifiers clearly separate.
evidence: Every directory directly under plan/ is snake_case and contains a manifest named _{dirname}.yaml after that directory
Every feature file under plan/{wagon_dirname}/features/ has a snake_case name
Every URN, slug field and YAML reference, in any file and for any entity type, is kebab-case
verifier_detail: Naming by surface (term naming_surface: surface -> format + pattern): urns_and_slugs = kebab-case (URNs, slug fields, references); directories = snake_case, plan/{wagon_dirname}/; manifest_files = _{dirname}.yaml at plan/{dirname}/_{dirname}.yaml (matches DIR name, not slug); feature_files = snake_case, plan/{wagon_dirname}/features/{feature_name}.yaml (underscores even though URNs use hyphens)
Normalisation: dirname = slug with '-' replaced by '_'. The manifest filename must equal '_' + dirname + '.yaml'.
